2506.def:
let VulnByCve = DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities
    | where CveId == "CVE-2026-49980"
    | project DeviceId, DeviceName, OSPlatform, SoftwareVendor, SoftwareName, SoftwareVersion, VulnerabilitySeverityLevel, RecommendedSecurityUpdate;
let VulnByInventory = DeviceTvmSoftwareInventory
    | where SoftwareName has "rclone"
    | extend Major = toint(extract(@"^(\d+)\.", 1, SoftwareVersion)),
             Minor = toint(extract(@"^\d+\.(\d+)", 1, SoftwareVersion)),
             Patch = toint(extract(@"^\d+\.\d+\.(\d+)", 1, SoftwareVersion))
    | where Major == 1 and (Minor < 74 or (Minor == 74 and Patch <= 2))
    | where Major == 1 and (Minor > 46 or (Minor == 46 and Patch >= 0))
    | project DeviceId, DeviceName, OSPlatform, SoftwareVendor, SoftwareName, SoftwareVersion, VulnerabilitySeverityLevel = "Critical", RecommendedSecurityUpdate = "Upgrade to rclone 1.74.3+";
union VulnByCve, VulnByInventory
| summarize arg_max(SoftwareVersion, *) by DeviceId
| join kind=leftouter (
    DeviceInfo
    | summarize arg_max(Timestamp, IsInternetFacing, PublicIP) by DeviceId
  ) on DeviceId
| project DeviceName, OSPlatform, SoftwareName, SoftwareVersion, VulnerabilitySeverityLevel, IsInternetFacing, PublicIP, RecommendedSecurityUpdate
| order by IsInternetFacing desc, DeviceName asc

date: 2026/06/17

      - 'uvicorn'
      - 'gunicorn'
  selection_path:
    TargetFilename|startswith:
      - '/etc/'
      - '/root/'
      - '/var/spool/cron'
      - '/usr/local/bin/'
    TargetFilename|contains:

2545.sigma:
title: GCS Bucket Creation Matching Vertex AI Predictable Staging Name (Bucket Squatting)
id: 9a0c8e21-7b2d-4f31-9c4a-3b8e0f7a1d22
status: experimental
description: Detects creation of a Google Cloud Storage bucket whose name matches the pre-v1.148.0 Vertex AI Python SDK's predictable default staging-bucket pattern '<projectId>-vertex-staging-<region>'. Pre-positioned squatted buckets enable the Unit 42 'Pickle in the Middle' cross-tenant RCE attack.
references:
    - https://thehackernews.com/2026/06/google-vertex-ai-sdk-flaw-let-attackers.html
    - https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/hijacking-vertex-ai-model/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/17
tags:
    - attack.resource_development
    - attack.t1583.001
    - attack.t1583.006
logsource:
    product: gcp
    service: gcp.audit
detection:
    selection:
        protoPayload.methodName: 'storage.buckets.create'
    bucket_pattern:
        protoPayload.resourceName|re: '.+-vertex-staging-[a-z]+[a-z0-9-]*$'
    filter_uuid_post_patch:
        protoPayload.resourceName|re: '.+-vertex-staging-[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}'
    condition: selection and bucket_pattern and not filter_uuid_post_patch
falsepositives:
    - Internal teams manually creating staging buckets that follow Vertex AI naming convention

| `drop_dm_object_name(All_Changes)`
| rex field=object "(?<bucket_name>[^/]+)$"
| where match(bucket_name, "(?i).+-vertex-staging-.+") AND NOT match(bucket_name, "-vertex-staging-[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}")

description: Detects load of AggregatorHost.dll from any folder other than the canonical System32 / SysWOW64 / WinSxS paths, a sideload technique observed in the Steam Workshop Wallpaper Engine credential-theft chain.
references:
  - https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/steam-workshop-abused-to-spread-malware-via-wallpaper-engine-app/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/16
tags:
  - attack.t1574.002
  - attack.t1036.005
logsource:
  category: image_load
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    ImageLoaded|endswith: '\AggregatorHost.dll'
  filter_legit:
    ImageLoaded|startswith:
      - 'C:\Windows\System32\'
      - 'C:\Windows\SysWOW64\'
      - 'C:\Windows\WinSxS\'
  condition: selection and not filter_legit
level: high
2552.spl: `sysmon` EventCode=7 ImageLoaded="*\\AggregatorHost.dll" NOT (ImageLoaded="*\\Windows\\System32\\AggregatorHost.dll" OR ImageLoaded="*\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\AggregatorHost.dll" OR ImageLoaded="*\\Windows\\WinSxS\\*\\AggregatorHost.dll") | stats min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Image) as loading_process values(Hashes) as dll_hashes count by host ImageLoaded User
2552.datadog: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:7 (@ImageLoaded:*\AggregatorHost.dll OR @ImageLoaded:*\aggregatorhost.dll OR @ImageLoaded:*\AGGREGATORHOST.DLL) -@ImageLoaded:(C\:\\Windows\\System32\\* OR C\:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\* OR C\:\\Windows\\WinSxS\\*)
2552.falcon:
#event_simpleName=ClassifiedModuleLoad OR #event_simpleName=ImageHash
| TargetFileName=/\\AggregatorHost\.dll$/i
| NOT TargetFileName=/^C:\\Windows\\(System32|SysWOW64|WinSxS)\\/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, TargetFileName, SHA256HashData], function=count())

// Article-specific bespoke detection — ClickFix Campaigns Expand Malware Delivery With New Loaders and Fake Update Lure
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.

| where (FileName in~ ("node.js", "mscoree.dll", "msvcp140.dll"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

description: PowerShell launched from explorer.exe (Win+R Run-dialog paste) with a hidden window flag and an inline download cmdlet pulling a ZIP, Node.js, MSI, or .dat payload — the canonical ClickFix entry point used to drop BabaDeda, Lorem Ipsum, and Potemkin loaders.

  selection_child:

    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where SyslogMessage has "cpanel_jsonapi_func=generateEcCert"
    | extend User = coalesce(extract(@"cpanel_jsonapi_user=([^&\s]+)", 1, SyslogMessage), extract(@"cpanel_jsonuser=([^&\s]+)", 1, SyslogMessage), extract(@"\suser=([^&\s]+)", 1, SyslogMessage))

| join kind=inner GenCalls on Computer, User

id: 6b3a4f1c-d2f5-4f0e-8e91-7c4a5a2c1d11
status: experimental
description: Detects POST requests to LiteLLM key/team management endpoints whose JSON body sets allowed_routes to a wildcard "/*", the authorization-bypass payload disclosed by Obsidian Security as the first link in the LiteLLM CVE-2026-47101 chain.
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/06/litellm-vulnerability-chain-lets-low.html
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/16

  - attack.t1068
  - attack.t1078.003
logsource:
  category: webserver
detection:

  selection_url:
    cs-uri-stem|contains:
      - '/key/generate'
      - '/key/update'
      - '/team/new'
      - '/team/update'

id: 4c1e8f2a-9d3b-4e7c-b6f1-2a8c9d4e5f63
status: experimental
description: Detects the LiteLLM Python proxy (uvicorn/gunicorn running litellm) spawning an OS shell, netcat, curl/wget, or another interpreter — the post-exploit footprint of the Custom Code Guardrail sandbox escape (CVE-2026-40217) and the stdio-MCP subprocess CVE (CVE-2026-42271, CISA KEV).
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/06/litellm-vulnerability-chain-lets-low.html
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/16
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.004
  - attack.t1059.006
  - attack.t1190
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: linux
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '/python'
      - '/python3'
      - '/python3.10'
      - '/python3.11'
      - '/python3.12'
      - '/uvicorn'
      - '/gunicorn'
    ParentCommandLine|contains:
      - 'litellm'
  selection_child_image:
    Image|endswith:
      - '/sh'
      - '/bash'
      - '/dash'
      - '/zsh'
      - '/nc'
      - '/ncat'
      - '/socat'
      - '/curl'
      - '/wget'
      - '/perl'
  selection_child_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'bash -i'
      - '/dev/tcp/'
      - 'os.system'
      - 'import pty'
      - 'socket.socket'
  condition: selection_parent and (selection_child_image or selection_child_cmd)
falsepositives:
  - LiteLLM custom guardrails legitimately shelling out to a vetted helper script (rare; should be vetted)
  - Container init scripts wrapping litellm with curl-based health checks
level: high

    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("ccl_segb_cli.py"))

       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path

      - '/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/security/pam_'

title: Webserver / PHP interpreter writes PHP-executable file to public web root (CVE-2026-48062)

description: |

  PHP-executable files (.php/.phar/.phtml/.phps/.pht) under common public web-roots. This is the
  landing-on-disk artefact of the CodeIgniter4 ext_in upload-validation bypass (CVE-2026-48062) where
  a file named shell.php with GIF-like content passed `ext_in[avatar,gif]`.
